Names 辣些年, 下班以后, 周末放映室, 一起造东西; counts 4人在线, 3人在线, 2人在线, 3人在线. No world map, no courtyard, no game movement, no decorative sidebar. Front-on screenshot, spacious balanced layout, all four cards fully visible. Match warm style of existing GoodPuppy room designs.

High quality front-on landscape Mac app screenshot with readable Chinese text.
